title: Bending radius against momentum
caption: r = p/(eB) rises in proportion to momentum. A 7 TeV/c proton (p = 3.7 × 10⁻¹⁵ kg m s⁻¹) in the LHC's 8.3 T has r = 2.8 km; doubling the field to 16.6 T halves it to 1.4 km.
alt: Two straight lines of bending radius in kilometres against proton momentum in TeV, the 8.3 tesla line reaching 2.8 km at 7 TeV and the 16.6 tesla line reaching 1.4 km.
description: r = p/(eB), p = 7 TeV/c = 3.7 × 10⁻¹⁵ kg m s⁻¹.
B = 16.6 T: r = 1.41 km, half as much.
